name: Brent Crude Rips: USDCAD & EURUSD Forward Returns
description: Event study analyzing FX forward returns (USDCAD, EURUSD, AUDUSD) after Brent crude oil surges 30%+ over a rolling 63-day window. Detects crossover events (first bar breaching threshold), then measures forward returns at +5d, +10d, and +20d horizons.
source:
# =============================================================================
# BRENT CRUDE RIPS: USDCAD & EURUSD FORWARD RETURNS
# =============================================================================
# Event: Brent crude rolling 63-day return crosses above +50%
# Uses crossover() to fire only on the first bar breaching the threshold
# Forward returns measured on USDCAD and EURUSD at +5d, +10d, +20d
# =============================================================================

src = market_data_source()()
close_fx = src.c
bar_idx = index()

# =============================================================================
# BRENT CRUDE DATA (SC Futures — Crude Oil Brent)
# =============================================================================

brent_raw = reference_futures(ticker="SC")()
brent_cont = futures_continuation(
    s_rollover_method=RolloverType.FirstOfMonth,
    s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.BackwardRatio
)(brent_raw.o, brent_raw.h, brent_raw.l, brent_raw.c, brent_raw.v, brent_raw.oi, brent_raw.s)
brent_close = ffill(brent_cont.c)

# =============================================================================
# ROLLING 63-DAY RETURN ON BRENT
# =============================================================================

brent_63d_ret = roc(period=63)(brent_close)

# =============================================================================
# EVENT DETECTION: First bar where 63-day return crosses above 50%
# =============================================================================

is_brent_rip = crossover(brent_63d_ret, 0.30)

# =============================================================================
# FORWARD RETURNS ON FX PAIRS (+5d, +10d, +20d)
# =============================================================================

post_5d = ((close_fx << 5) - close_fx) / close_fx
post_10d = ((close_fx << 10) - close_fx) / close_fx
post_20d = ((close_fx << 20) - close_fx) / close_fx

# =============================================================================
# EVENT-FILTERED RETURNS
# =============================================================================

rip_post5 = where(is_brent_rip, post_5d)
rip_post10 = where(is_brent_rip, post_10d)
rip_post20 = where(is_brent_rip, post_20d)

# Hit rates: 1.0 if forward return > 0, else 0.0 (on event days only)
hit_5d = where(is_brent_rip, 1.0 if post_5d > 0 else 0.0)
hit_10d = where(is_brent_rip, 1.0 if post_10d > 0 else 0.0)
hit_20d = where(is_brent_rip, 1.0 if post_20d > 0 else 0.0)

# Event count (1.0 per event for summing)
rip_count = where(is_brent_rip, 1.0)

# Oil return on event day for markers
ev_brent_ret = where(is_brent_rip, brent_63d_ret)

# =============================================================================
# DASHBOARD: Cross-Sectional Summary Table
# =============================================================================

cs_summary_table(
    title='Brent Rip (+30% in 63d): FX Forward Returns',
    category='Brent Rip FX Impact',
    agg=AggregationType.Sum,
    schema=TableReportSchema(
        title='FX Forward Returns After Brent Rips (30% Threshold)',
        include_timestamp=False,
        columns=[
            ColumnSpec(title='Event Count', type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat, grid_agg=AggregationType.Sum),
            ColumnSpec(title='Avg +5d Return', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean),
            ColumnSpec(title='Avg +10d Return', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean),
            ColumnSpec(title='Avg +20d Return', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean),
            ColumnSpec(title='Hit Rate +5d', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean),
            ColumnSpec(title='Hit Rate +10d', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean),
            ColumnSpec(title='Hit Rate +20d', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean)
        ]
    ),
    order=0
)(rip_count, rip_post5, rip_post10, rip_post20, hit_5d, hit_10d, hit_20d)

# =============================================================================
# DASHBOARD: Cross-Sectional Bar Chart — Avg Forward Returns by Horizon
# =============================================================================

cs_bars(
    title='Avg FX Forward Returns After Brent Crude Rips (+30% in 63d)',
    category='Brent Rip FX Impact',
    agg=AggregationType.Mean,
    data_labels=True,
    color_by_value=True,
    y_axis_label='Avg Forward Return',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    series_names=['+5d', '+10d', '+20d'],
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    order=1
)(rip_post5, rip_post10, rip_post20)

# =============================================================================
# EVENT MARKERS: Brent Rip on FX Charts (5d/10d/20d forward returns)
# =============================================================================

event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title='Brent Crude Rip (+30% in 63d)',
        icon=Icon.ZapIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(type=CardRenderType.BooleanFormat, table_is_filter=True),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Hero, title='Brent 63d Return', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Details, title='FX +5d Return', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Details, title='FX +10d Return', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Details, title='FX +20d Return', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2)
        ]
    )
)(is_brent_rip, ev_brent_ret, rip_post5, rip_post10, rip_post20)
